interface.longDescription:
Analyze Google Search Console (GSC) data in ChatGPT with LoomaScale. Get SEO reports from your connected properties, investigate organic traffic drops, find keyword opportunities and low-CTR pages, and check URL indexing and sitemap errors. Built for SEO specialists, marketers, agencies and business owners. Search Console access is read-only.

Why did my organic search traffic drop?
Compare clicks, impressions, click-through rate (CTR) and average position between two periods. Break down gains and losses by page or search query to see where performance changed. Reports use finalized data by default and identify recent partial days when included. Changes show where to investigate, not proof of a particular cause.

Which keywords and pages should I improve first?
Find search queries ranking just below the top results and pages with high impressions but few clicks. Exclude brand terms to focus on non-brand keyword opportunities. Prioritize using average position, CTR and estimated click potential. Estimates use a typical CTR curve and do not guarantee more traffic or better rankings.

Is my page indexed in Google?
Use URL Inspection for up to 10 URLs per call to read Google's stored indexing status, chosen canonical URL and last crawl. Investigate reported noindex exclusions, canonical mismatches or pages crawled but not indexed. This reads Google's existing records; it does not run a live page test or request indexing.

Are my sitemaps being processed?
Check submitted sitemaps, their last download, processing status, and Google's reported errors and warnings. The integration reads sitemap status; it does not submit or delete sitemaps.

What are the limits?
Reports cover your accessible Search Console properties and up to 16 months of available history. Keyword positions are historical averages, not live rank tracking. This integration does not crawl websites, modify pages or settings, or provide Google Ads or Google Analytics reports.

How do I connect Search Console?
Sign in to LoomaScale, connect Google Search Console through Google's read-only authorization, then ask about your site in ChatGPT. Helper tools check your usage allowance or send a feature request when you ask.

LoomaScale is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

name: loomascale-gsc

positive.description: List the Search Console properties the connected Google login can read.
positive.prompt: Which Google Search Console properties can you see in my account?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns each verified property (sc-domain: or URL-prefix) with the login's permission level. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Compare organic search traffic between two periods without a product name in the request.
positive.prompt: For my first connected website, compare organic Google search clicks for the last 28 days with the previous 28, then show the 10 pages with the biggest click change.
positive.expected_behavior: States both exact windows, reports total clicks, impressions, CTR and position for each with the change, then lists the 10 pages ranked by absolute click change. Labels coverage limits. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find striking-distance queries excluding brand terms.
positive.prompt: Which queries in my first Search Console property rank just below the top 3 with good impressions? Leave out queries containing my site's name.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists queries with their average position, impressions, clicks and estimated click potential, excludes the brand term, and explains that potential is an estimate from a typical CTR curve. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Find pages with weak click-through rate for their impressions.
positive.prompt: Which pages in my first Search Console property get many impressions but few clicks?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pages with impressions, clicks, CTR, position and estimated click potential, ordered by potential. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Is the home page of my first Search Console property indexed, and were my sitemaps processed without errors?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Google's stored coverage state, chosen canonical and last crawl for the URL, then each sitemap with its last download, warnings and errors. Says it did not run a live test or request indexing.

negative.description: Ad campaign changes are outside the Search Console integration.
negative.prompt: Raise the budget of my Google Ads search campaign to $50 a day.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; Search Console reports organic search only and cannot change ad campaigns.

negative.prompt: Request indexing for my new blog post in Google.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked to request indexing; explain that this read-only integration can inspect stored index status but cannot submit indexing requests, which are made in Search Console.

negative.description: A general SEO definition needs no account data.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between impressions and clicks in Google Search Console? Just explain.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer the conceptual question without invoking the app, reading properties or requesting authorization.
